title: Dealer sorting issues and error messages
summary: This topic combines dealer follow-up, attempts to resolve faults, and recurring error-message references, with many fragments too brief to show clear sentiment.

positive.summary: The only positive review praises an engineer for successfully resolving the issue.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe faults and teething issues that were difficult to resolve with dealer support.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention sorting problems, dealer chasing, delays, and error messages, but they are too brief or unclear to confirm sentiment.

limitations: Many fragments are very short or lack context, so sentiment cannot be determined reliably.
The cluster mixes several loosely related subjects, including dealer administration, technical error messages, pickup delays, and an unrelated comment about entering or exiting on an incline.
Examples are stratified samples and are not representative estimates of the broader owner population.
